overview_description.description: Zinier’s low-code field service automation platform empowers field service organizations with the combined power of humans and technology to keep our world up and running. Powered by AI, Zinier transforms how teams coordinate and execute work, so they can solve problems faster, fix things before they break, and maintain an agile infrastructure that evolves with their needs. Enterprises around the world use Zinier to reach their full potential, delivering always-on service now, while future-proofing for the unexpected.  We are a global team headquartered in Silicon Valley with leading investors including Accel, ICONIQ Capital, Founders Fund, Newfund Capital, NGP Capital, Tiger Global Management and Qualcomm Ventures LLC.

about_short_description.short_description: Zinier offers a low-code field service automation platform that provides a combined power of humans and technology.

product.name: Z Productivity Suite
product.description: A cloud-based platform for managing field service operations including planning, execution, collaboration, and training.

product.name: Z Sidekick
product.description: A generative AI tool that provides real-time insights and automates routine tasks in field service management.

product.name: Studio Z
product.description: A low-code/no-code workflow builder platform for creating and customizing field service workflows without coding.

product.name: Scheduling & Dispatch
product.description: A tool for intelligent task assignment and route optimization to schedule field technicians efficiently.

product.name: Capacity Management
product.description: A solution to forecast, plan, and adjust workforce capacity to meet fluctuating demand in field service operations.

product.name: Parts & Inventory Tracking
product.description: A system to track parts and inventory from warehouses to field technicians, ensuring material availability for service tasks.
